blurb: Catawba Riverkeeper is the only non-profit, on-the-water advocate for the entire 8,900 miles of waterways in the Catawba-Wateree River Basin. They provide science-based information about water and issues affecting it. They offer educational experiences including camps, field trips, half day programs, and adult workshops to teach about river ecology and conservation.
